Relationships and trends.createScatterPlot: One row per observation; x and y fields
Relationships and trends.createLinePlot: Ordered positions and measures; explicit aggregation when needed
Relationships and trends.createAreaPlot: Ordered values and a baseline, or paired interval bounds
Relationships and trends.createRegressionPlot: Finite quantitative observations for a fit and optional uncertainty
Relationships and trends.createPolarScatterPlot: Angular and radial fields per observation
Relationships and trends.createRadarPlot: Long category/value rows or explicitly selected wide fields
Relationships and trends.createParallelCoordinates: Rows with two or more quantitative or ordinal dimensions
Relationships and trends.createTextPlot: Positioned text from x/y fields and row content

Comparisons and intervals.createBarPlot: Categorical/measure roles, explicit summary, or ranged endpoints
Comparisons and intervals.createDotPlot: Category and measure per raw row, or an explicit summary
Comparisons and intervals.createLollipopPlot: Category, measure, and a finite baseline
Comparisons and intervals.createDumbbellPlot: Category plus named start and end measurements
Comparisons and intervals.createIntervalPlot: Center and interval measurements or a statistical interval definition

Distributions.createHistogram: Quantitative observations; one bin policy; optional weights
Distributions.createDensityPlot: Finite numeric observations and KDE decisions
Distributions.createECDFPlot: Numeric support observations; optional group and weight field
Distributions.createBoxPlot: One categorical and one quantitative role; constructor may defer roles
Distributions.createGradientPlot: Category and quantitative profile roles; constructor may defer roles
Distributions.createViolinPlot: Category and quantitative measure; optional two-value split
Distributions.createStripPlot: One measure, optionally with a categorical slot
Distributions.createBeeswarmPlot: Category and measure for glyph-aware deterministic packing
Distributions.createRaincloudPlot: Shared category/measure rows for density, summary, and observations

Parts, radial values, and dense samples.createPiePlot: Category counts or category sums for proportional sector angles
Parts, radial values, and dense samples.createRosePlot: Category counts or sums represented by sector area
Parts, radial values, and dense samples.createRadialBarPlot: Category counts or sums represented by radial length
Parts, radial values, and dense samples.createHeatmap: Pre-gridded cells or two raw quantitative fields for rectangular bins
Parts, radial values, and dense samples.createHorizonPlot: Ordered quantitative/temporal x and foldable quantitative y

Repeated chart structure.facet: One complete chart and an eligible shared ancestor field
Repeated chart structure.facetGrid: One complete chart plus row and column fields
Repeated chart structure.repeatCharts: One eligible mark role and an ordered field list
